```{r}
key_cols <- c("subject_id", "hadm_id", "stay_id", "window_index")

base_cols <- names(merged_dt)  # 记录基准表的列名
```

```{r}
# ---------- 第二步：循环合并剩余文件 ----------
for (f in time_varying_files[-1]) {
  # 先读取该文件的列名（不读全部数据）
  tmp_cols <- names(fread(file.path(path, f), nrows = 0))
  
  # 该文件中属于“独有”的列：不在基准列中，且不是键列
  extra_cols <- setdiff(tmp_cols, c(base_cols, key_cols))
  
  # 如果没有任何独有列，跳过该文件（或警告）
  if (length(extra_cols) == 0) {
    message(paste("文件", f, "没有新增列，跳过合并"))
    next
  }
  
  # 读取该文件，只选择键列 + 独有列
  dt <- fread(file.path(path, f), select = c(key_cols, extra_cols))
  
  # 横向合并（此时不会产生重复列，因为非键列都是新的）
  merged_dt <- merge(merged_dt, dt, by = key_cols, all = TRUE)
  
  # 更新基准列名（新增的列名加入 base_cols）
  base_cols <- names(merged_dt)
  
  rm(dt); gc()  # 释放内存
}

```

```{r}
# 功能：读取衍生表，自动将 icustay_id 重命名为 stay_id
load_derived <- function(table_name, value_cols, time_col = "charttime") {
  
  file_path <- file.path("D:/mimiciv_derived", paste0(table_name, ".csv"))
  
  # 1. 先读前0行，获取列名
  header <- fread(file_path, nrows = 0)
  all_names <- names(header)
  
  # 2. 检测ID列（优先用 stay_id，如果不存在则用 icustay_id）
  id_col <- NULL
  if ("stay_id" %in% all_names) {
    id_col <- "stay_id"
  } else if ("icustay_id" %in% all_names) {
    id_col <- "icustay_id"
  } else {
    stop(paste("表", table_name, "中找不到 stay_id 或 icustay_id。"))
  }
  
  # 3. 只读取存在的列（避免因列名缺失而报错）
  select_cols <- intersect(c(id_col, time_col, value_cols), all_names)
  if (length(select_cols) < 2) {
    stop(paste("表", table_name, "中缺少必要的列。"))
  }
  
  dt <- fread(file_path, select = select_cols)
  
  # 4. 统一列名：将 icustay_id 改为 stay_id
  if (id_col != "stay_id") {
    setnames(dt, id_col, "stay_id")
  }
  
  # 5. 转换时间格式
  dt[, (time_col) := as.POSIXct(get(time_col))]
  
  return(dt)
}
```

```{r}
#计算Elixhauser（R包，comorbidity）

library(comorbidity)
```
```{r}
# 1. 读取数据
  diagnoses_icd <- fread("D:/mimiciv_derived/diagnoses_icd.csv",
                         select = c("hadm_id", "icd_version", "icd_code"))

  # 2. 按 ICD 版本拆分，分别计算
  elix_9 <- comorbidity(
      x       = diagnoses_icd[icd_version == 9],
      id      = "hadm_id",
      code    = "icd_code",
      map     = "elixhauser_icd9_quan",
      assign0 = FALSE
  )

  elix_10 <- comorbidity(
      x       = diagnoses_icd[icd_version == 10],
      id      = "hadm_id",
      code    = "icd_code",
      map     = "elixhauser_icd10_quan",
      assign0 = FALSE
  )

   # 3. 合并两部分
  elix_combined <- rbind(elix_9, elix_10)
  setDT(elix_combined)
  elix_combined <- elix_combined[, lapply(.SD, max), by = hadm_id]

  # 4. 手动计算 van Walraven 加权分（避免 score() 的属性和 map 匹配问题）
  vw_weights <- c(
      chf = 7,     carit = 5,    valv = -1,   pcd = 4,      pvd = 2,
      hypunc = 0,  hypc = 0,     para = 7,    ond = 6,      cpd = 3,
      diabunc = 0, diabc = 0,    hypothy = 0, rf = 5,       ld = 11,
      pud = 0,     aids = 0,     lymph = 9,   metacanc = 12, solidtum = 4,
      rheumd = 0,  coag = 3,     obes = -4,   wloss = 6,    fed = 5,
      blane = -2,  dane = -2,    alcohol = 0, drug = -7,    psycho = 0,
      depre = -3
  )

  comorb_cols <- names(vw_weights)
  elix_scores <- elix_combined[, .(
      hadm_id,
      elixhauser = rowSums(.SD * vw_weights[comorb_cols])
  ), .SDcols = comorb_cols]

  # 5. 合并到主数据
  all_data[elix_scores, elixhauser := i.elixhauser, on = "hadm_id"]
```

```{r}
library(data.table)

# 确保 all_data 是 data.table
setDT(all_data)

# 定义需要导出的列（对应48维清单 + 标识列）
# 注意：放弃 Readmission，Elixhauser 使用 elixhauser（若不存在则用 elixhauser_vw）
export_cols <- c(
  "subject_id", "stay_id", "window_index", "hadm_id","window_start", "window_end",  # 标识列
  "demo_anchor_age",          # Age
  "gender",                   # Gender
  "shock_index",              # Shock Index
  "elixhauser",               # Elixhauser (或 elixhauser_vw)
  "gcs",                      # GCS
  "sirs",                     # SIRS
  "sofa_sofa2_total",         # SOFA
  "lab_lactate",              # Arterial Lactate
  "lab_bicarbonate",          # Bicarbonate
  "lab_inr",                  # INR
  "lab_sodium",               # Sodium
  "lab_wbc",                  # WBC Count
  "serum_co2",                # Serum CO₂
  "lab_creatinine",           # Creatinine
  "lab_calcium_ionized",      # Ionised Calcium
  "ast",                      # SGOT/AST
  "pt",                       # Prothrombin Time (PT)
  "lab_platelet_count",       # Platelets Count
  "lab_bilirubin_total",      # Total Bilirubin
  "lab_albumin",              # Albumin
  "lab_calcium_total",        # Calcium (Total)
  "lab_glucose",              # Glucose
  "lab_hemoglobin",           # Hemoglobin
  "lab_ptt",                  # PTT
  "lab_potassium",            # Potassium
  "alt",                      # SGPT/ALT
  "abg_arterial_flag",        # Arterial Blood Gas marker
  "lab_bun",                  # BUN
  "lab_chloride",             # Chloride
  "lab_ph",                   # Arterial pH
  "lab_magnesium",            # Magnesium
  "vital_dbp",                # Diastolic BP
  "vital_map",                # Mean BP
  "vital_resp_rate",          # Respiratory Rate
  "vital_spo2",               # SpO2
  "vital_sbp",                # Systolic BP
  "lab_pco2",                 # PaCO2
  "lab_po2",                  # PaO2
  "fio2",                     # FiO2
  "pf_ratio",                 # PaO2/FiO2 Ratio (from bg)
  "vital_temperature",        # Temperature
  "weight_weight_kg",         # Weight
  "vital_heart_rate",         # Heart Rate
  "total_fluid_output",       # Total Fluid Output
  "mechanical_ventilation",   # Mechanical Ventilation
  "urine_urine_output_4h_ml", # Fluid Output - 4h
  "readmission_30d"           #readmission(=0)
  )

# 检查哪些列实际存在
existing_cols <- intersect(export_cols, names(all_data))
missing_cols <- setdiff(export_cols, existing_cols)

# 如果 elixhauser 不存在，尝试用 elixhauser_vw 替代
if (!"elixhauser" %in% existing_cols && "elixhauser_vw" %in% names(all_data)) {
  message("elixhauser 列不存在，将使用 elixhauser_vw 替代。")
  export_cols[export_cols == "elixhauser"] <- "elixhauser_vw"
  existing_cols <- intersect(export_cols, names(all_data))
  missing_cols <- setdiff(export_cols, existing_cols)
}

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  cat("以下列未找到，将被忽略：", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# 只选择存在的列
final_data <- all_data[, ..existing_cols]
```

```{r}
# 计算每列的缺失数量
na_count <- sapply(final_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))

# 计算缺失比例（百分比，保留两位小数）
na_pct <- round(na_count / nrow(final_data) * 100, 2)

# 汇总为数据表
na_summary <- data.table(
  column = names(final_data),
  missing_count = na_count,
  missing_pct = na_pct
)

# 按缺失比例降序排列，方便查看缺失严重的列
setorder(na_summary, -missing_pct)

# 打印结果
print(na_summary)

# 可选：保存为 CSV，方便在 Excel 中查看
fwrite(na_summary, "missing_summary.csv")
```
